stem: My sister ___ to school by bus every day.
explanation: My sister — это she, поэтому в Present Simple глагол получает -s: goes.

options.text: There is a cat in the park.
There are a cat in the park.
There have a cat in the park.
There be a cat in the park.

explanation: С одним предметом (a cat) нужен There is. There are — для нескольких предметов.
